Session 10 Prep: The Last Clear Water

Continues from: Session 9 Summary Arc: Finish Clearing the Corruption → begin The Princess and the Dragon Estimated Length: ~2 hours 55 minutes, including a 10-minute break; optional continuation cards below provide another 60–100 minutes to choose from Asset Checklist: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.0da13e7285047afe]{session10 asset checklist} Adventure continuation: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.229394898ce8db16]{princess and dragon runbook} · @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.df71b0ea5d323b91]{princess and dragon tracker} Handouts: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.132d40f913a93bb9]{princess and dragon handouts} Layout: this folder holds the session hub and asset checklist; scenes/ holds the individual scene scripts. Shared adventure references remain in prep/.

1. Where Session 9 Left Off

The party has cleared Brokenhill Silver Mine. Together with the Rocky Passages, that makes two footholds completed. Pristine Pond remains. Session 9's actual-play audio was not recorded; its summary is based on the group's after-session recollections. Do not fill inventory gaps with the old prep's unconfirmed loot.

Party status and carry-forward

Copied from 00 campaign state for this prep; recheck Foundry at the table:

PC Current facts Session 10 opportunity
Filly, Wild Heart, level 3 Reported 0 HP and “doubly befuddled”; hatchet dissolved. Silver spike confirmed; Tawny has silver claws. Recover first; protect the pixies and earn the Lunar Grotto Spear. Talk with Scamp if the cave is reached.
Vega, Elemental Connection, level 3 Acquired Vein-Breaker; cutlass and spyglass dissolved. Has Heartstone and crafted silver punching glove. Shape the pond defense; later inspect the gnomish necklace construction.
Marigold, Healing Touch, level 3 Knocked down; final HP/wound unspecified. Staff and silver dagger retained. Hair charms were recalled as 1 temporary HP each to Filly/Vega, not guaranteed remaining HP. Purify corruption or protect an ally; respond to frightened Dragon Amy with empathy.

Confirmed session 9 rewards: each PC received one Potion of Stone Strength and one pair of Gilded Dwarven Goggles. 76 SP was reported from the snakes; confirm allocation. Three silver chunks were consumed to make the silver claws, spike, and glove; do not add them again. No Troll's Tooth or other unmentioned mine treasure is assumed.

Earlier carry-forward, with no change reported: 2 Corruption Cure potions · Amulet of the Forest Guardian (2 GD) · Moonstone Ring · Elixir of Moonlit Grace · Engraved Fey Silver Chalice (50 SP) · net · fishing pole · Silas's Silver Rolling Pin · silver pitcher (d4) · Mari Lwyd's Teeth · Rainbow Crystal · Tawny's Blessing · Heartstone · Golden Unicorn Tear. Exact totals, uses, and item statistics remain on the Foundry sheets.

Players know: the Baron served the Fairy Queen; the mine corruption is cleared. They have not been shown Amy's predicament, met the Scorchwoods knights, or acquired the pond spear. Morwenna's name and PPS-founding secret are not established as player knowledge.

Before the first scene — GM checklist

  • [ ] Confirm the group's full Rest, food, healing/stabilization, and any persistent wound/trauma effects. @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.d9add24ff569f7db]{03 Combat and Adventuring}: safe 8-hour Rest restores HP/HD/GD; a Picnic spends HD and does not refresh them. Apply each ailment/wound's own recovery condition in @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.6419c9817f5f6c41]{04 Wounds and Trauma}. “Doubly befuddled” is Filly's recap wording, not a newly invented stacked penalty.

  • [ ] Confirm HP on sheets, remove the melted equipment, and use the GM-confirmed silver spike. Do not invent damage dice for the newly crafted silver gear.

  • [ ] Confirm the 76 SP allocation and goggles/potion entries. Leave unconfirmed loot unawarded.

  • [ ] Open the existing Pristine Pond world scene (GM confirms it is already created; it is not in the module): northern treeline, clear water, banks, shelter for pixies. Have six crawler tokens and one Bloom ready if using the full encounter.

  • [ ] Queue @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.198226ac753d9f5f]{The Lunar Grotto Spear} and the revised dispatch in @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.132d40f913a93bb9]{princess and dragon handouts}.

  • [ ] Mark the Knight Tracker NOT STARTED. The mine Rest, pond, grove, and transition nightmare are before the book's active hunt procedure.

  • [ ] Use @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.229394898ce8db16]{princess and dragon runbook} for book corrections; do not read the old session 9 dispatch that says the key was destroyed.

2. Session Flow Cheat Sheet

SESSION 10 — THE LAST CLEAR WATER                      175 minutes
ACT I: FINISH WHAT YOU STARTED
  1. Recap, recovery, equipment check                   15 min
  2. Pond: pranks, Thistledown, riddle                   15 min
  3. Defend the pond                                   35 min
  4. Filly's spear and the healed forest                10 min
  ☕ BREAK                                             10 min
ACT II: SOMEONE ELSE NEEDS HELP
  5. Aurelius's vision and questions                    20 min
  6. Nightmare, Nim's dispatch, compass                 10 min
ACT III: THE PRINCESS IS THE DRAGON
  7. Hidden tunnel and Dragon Panic                    30 min
  8. Amy's account, Scamp, choose a rescue plan          20 min
  9. Record state and next destination                  10 min

These are budgets, not plot requirements. The recommended end is Amy calmed and the players choosing their first rescue lead. If the pond takes most of the evening, end with the compass/mission and open the next session at the cave. Continue to a nearby location only if there is real time to play the choice; the whole adventure is already prepared in the runbook.

Foundry scene quick reference

Scene names below match End Game Scenes in module 0.6.0 exactly. Import the scene into your world before activating it. These are scene choices, not confirmation of live setup; existing backdrops have no walls.

Prep beat Foundry scene to use At-table setup
Recovery and mine departure Brokenhill Silver Mine Keep the cleared mine visible for the recap and Rest.
Pond pranks, riddle, defense, spear reward Pristine Pond — existing world scene Already created, confirmed by the GM. It is outside the module; no new pond scene or map is needed. Enchanted Pool is the later Wish Fish location.
Aurelius's vision No dedicated grove scene Keep your Pristine Pond backdrop for the conversation and show Aurelius's portrait. This is a visual stand-in, not a change of location.
Nightmare, Nim's dispatch, compass blessing No dedicated module scene Keep the neutral pond/grove backdrop; narrate the dream and show the dispatch separately.
Journey into the Scorchwoods The Scorchwoods (Overworld) — GM reference Check for secret paths before sharing; otherwise narrate the journey without activating this map for players.
Hidden tunnel, Dragon Panic, Amy's account Your existing Dragon’s Cave map (module reference: Dragon Cave Lair) Use the GM’s map; identify tunnel, barrier and hoard positions before play.

The matching scene is also noted in each linked scene note. Later locations have the same cues in @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.229394898ce8db16]{princess and dragon runbook}.

3. Detailed scene notes

Open a scene note to run it. Each is designed to run without opening the book: narrated beats, NPC conversations and responses, clues and handout text, encounter rules, outcomes and its own asset/setup list. Suggested dialogue is adaptable; it never dictates a PC's response. The first nine are the main session; the final eleven cover the remaining locations, rescue finale, and conclusion. These are a menu for however many sessions the adventure takes.

Break: after scene 4, take 10 minutes and record rewards/resources. Close: reserve 10 minutes to record the stopping point. The cave arrival/panic notes share one 30-minute budget. At the break, record actual HP, spent dice, potion use and the spear's owner. If considering advancement, explicitly decide it using @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.1d6f48186e4ccd65]{05 Character Building}; no automatic level gain is assumed.

4. Optional continuation — choosing extra scenes

Use these after Amy's account if time remains. They are a menu, not additional compulsory acts. Leave the main 175-minute schedule intact; choose one or two scene notes to fit the players' plan. Scenes 10–20 prepare the entire remaining rescue; do not try to fit them all into one evening. Move unvisited notes into the next session folder as needed, keeping their basenames so links continue to work.

Before moving: record Amy's HP, companions staying behind, and the starting hunt value (2 or 3 from the orb). For each journey to a new keyed location, roll the book's separate d4 knight check and d4 Wrinkle check (each triggers on 1). Ordinary successful movement alone adds no point; Spend Time and actual Wrinkles do. Apply the full tracker procedure and any urgent lair arrival even during these optional scenes. Never postpone the danger just to finish a scene.

6. GM Tools

These tables are for the Scorchwoods after entry, not automatic extra fights during the pond/grove transition. Sources: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.311bdae24626b41d]{Scorchwoods Wrinkles} and @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.95f00957202cd8a0]{Whisper Table}. Travel/clock procedure is in @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.229394898ce8db16]{princess and dragon runbook}.

7. Handout Prep

Use @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.132d40f913a93bb9]{princess and dragon handouts}:

  • A: Daisy's dispatch at the grove.

  • B: compass reminder when pins are blessed.

  • C–F: future adventure clues; reveal only when found.

Show pond and spear art at the appropriate moments. Use the black-dragon verbal description even if existing art is red; asset consistency is flagged in @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.0da13e7285047afe]{session10 asset checklist}. Never share the full GM map, answer key, or runbook as a player handout by accident.

8. Potential Session End Points

  1. ⭐ Recommended: Amy calmed, problem understood, first rescue lead chosen. The next session opens on a player decision.
  2. If the pond runs long: finish Aurelius's mission and give the compass; end at the mouth of the hidden tunnel.
  3. If combat dominates: end with Filly receiving the spear and the forest healing. Keep the vision and entire book opening for next time.
  4. If the group moves quickly: use the optional scene notes linked above. End after recovering the stick, entering the village, agreeing to Pippin's terms, or securing an alliance. Record the real tracker changes; do not rush the key chain or predetermine which knight reaches the cave.

At close record actual rewards, reveals, recovery, remaining consumables, and the exact stopping location. This prep does not advance campaign canon until played.
